business_summary.text: Aequs is an engineering-led precision manufacturer operating vertically integrated clusters in India (Belagavi, Koppal, Hubballi) plus sites in France and the US, serving aerospace OEMs and consumer products customers.

call_points.text: Path to consumer EBITDA breakeven is being recalibrated due to slower volume ramp.
call_points.versus_prior: timeline under review from previous Q4FY27 target

call_points.text: Consumer EBITDA breakeven targeted by Q4FY27 and consolidated PAT breakeven by H1FY28, both reiterated as milestones.
Vision 2031 roadmap restated: 4–6x revenue growth, 18–22% EBITDA margin and 20% steady-state RoCE.
Aerospace order book crossed USD 1,004 Mn, up 13% sequentially.
Signed long-term agreements with two new Aerostructures Tier-1 customers in the quarter.
First contract for fully assembled Airbus A320 wheels with Safran Landing Systems, to be made end-to-end in India.
₹830 Mn capex invested in Q1FY27 to support future growth.
Operational EBITDA (ex other income) rose to ₹148 Mn from ₹42 Mn in Q4FY26, a 300 bps margin gain.
YoY EBITDA decline attributed to Consumer Electronics operating costs being expensed in Q1FY27 versus capitalised in Q1FY26.
Operating cash flow was negative ₹414 Mn in Q1FY27 versus positive ₹274 Mn a year ago.
PAT loss of ₹532 Mn reflects EBITDA movement and higher depreciation on the expanded Consumer Electronics asset base.
Management guides FY27 consolidated top-line revenue growth of approximately 45% to 50%.
Operational EBITDA is projected to double in FY27 on embedded operating leverage.
Aerospace guided to deliver 25% to 30% revenue growth in FY27 with segment EBITDA margin held at 20%.
Consumer segment EBITDA targeted to reach breakeven by Q4 FY27 as utilization ramps.
Consumer segment revenue guided to grow 125% to 150% in FY27 driven by consumer electronics.
Consolidated PAT expected to reach break-even by H1 FY28 as depreciation load is absorbed.
Planned FY27 capex is approximately ₹160 Cr for aerospace and ₹500 Cr for consumer.
Signed long-term agreement with Mattel, expecting volumes to absorb capacity impact from Hasbro.
FY27 capex will be funded through debt borrowings and internal accruals.
CFO Dinesh Iyer to step down at the end of June 2026 for personal reasons; search underway.

timeline.summary: Aequs invested ₹10 Cr via a rights issue in its wholly owned subsidiary Aequs Force Consumer Products using IPO proceeds.

2026-04-20: Aequs's wholly owned subsidiary Aequs Engineered Plastics received a Hasbro email signalling intent to cease placing purchase orders; the MSA is not terminated and impact is being assessed.
On April 23, 2026, Aequs approved the amalgamation of three wholly owned subsidiaries (ASMIPL, AEPPL, AFCPPL) with the parent company.
2026-04-24: CARE Ratings' monitoring report for Q4FY26 showed ₹481.32 Cr of the ₹670 Cr IPO proceeds utilised, with no material deviation from objects.
Aequs Limited, led by Ravi Mallikarjun Hugar, scheduled its first Investor Day on June 18, 2026, in Mumbai.
On May 7, 2026, Aequs reported that CARE Ratings placed the bank facilities of Aequs and its material subsidiaries under Rating Watch with Developing Implications.
Aequs group and IIT Dharwad established an advanced materials science and manufacturing R&D ecosystem at IIT-D campus.

Aequs Limited, led by **Mr. Aravind Melligeri (Executive Chairman & CEO)**, **Mr. Rajeev Kaul (Cofounder & Managing Director)**, **Mr. Dinesh Iyer (CFO)**, and **Mr. Harish Bang (VP-Finance)**, scheduled a Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on **May 26, 2026, at 6:00 PM IST** via dial-in.
On May 22, 2026, Aequs announced an investment of ₹9.30 Cr via a rights issue in its 50% joint venture Aequs Cookware Private Limited using IPO proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹367.1 Cr, net loss ₹53.72 Cr.
Aequs reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,230.44 Cr up 33% YoY and EBITDA of ₹154.5 Cr up 43% YoY, backed by an aerospace order book of USD 889 Mn.
Ravi Mallikarjun Hugar, Compliance Officer, hosted earnings conference call for Q4 & FY 2025-26 results on May 26, 2026, at 6:00 PM IST; audio available at **aequs.com/investor**.
Ravi Mallikarjun Hugar, Managing Director, confirms Aequs Limited’s participation in Citi’s 2026 India Conference on June 5, 2026, in Mumbai.
Aequs guided 45-50% FY27 consolidated revenue growth and consumer EBITDA breakeven by Q4FY27 on ₹660 Cr planned capex.
On June 01, 2026, Aequs Consumer Products received ESDM incentive sanction from the Government of Karnataka for its Dharwad facility.
Aequs announced that the Regional Director rejected its scheme of amalgamation for three subsidiaries under Section 233.
Aequs issued a corrigendum to its EGM notice providing pricing details and post-issue shareholding for the preferential warrant issue to its promoter.
Aequs Limited passed resolution to offer, issue and allot warrants convertible into equity shares to Mellwood Trustee Services Private Limited on preferential basis at EGM on October 22, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹409.08 Cr, net loss ₹52.39 Cr.
Aequs reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹409.10 Cr, up 45% YoY, driven by aerospace growth while consumer ramp was delayed by qualification timelines.
Audio recording of earnings conference call for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 held on October 26, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. (IST) is available on the company website.
